scenario_description: A query whose vocabulary genuinely overlaps the real 'checkout-server-errors' runbook must retrieve it within a small, bounded top-k -- the same ranking-contract query retrieval-service's own existing test_retrieval_quality_smoke.py already proves against the real corpus.

provenance.notes: Query and expected runbook are taken directly from services/retrieval-service/tests/test_retrieval_quality_smoke.py's own existing, already-proven parametrized case -- this is the REAL, source-controlled knowledge/runbooks/checkout-server-errors.md file, never a synthetic document.

ground_truth_rationale: A human reviewer confirms knowledge/runbooks/checkout-server-errors.md is genuinely about checkout 5xx errors caused by an unavailable payment dependency -- the query's vocabulary was chosen to overlap that runbook's own real title/content, matching the already-reviewed smoke test this case reuses.
acceptable_variations: exact rank within top-5 may vary with corpus/chunking changes; only membership in top-5 is asserted
forbidden_outcomes: the relevant runbook never appearing in the top-5 for this query
